title: Reply and write captions in Roman Urdu as well as English
action: Answer comments in the language they are written in, and add a Roman Urdu line about price and availability to the caption.
evidence: 26% of comments are in Roman Urdu. Among topic comments, price, location and discount questions make up 49% of Roman Urdu comments but only 21% of English ones.

title: Use the song and the models: name the song and release more of it
action: Write the song name in the description, release the full song or a behind-the-scenes clip, and tag the models.
evidence: 278 comments (11.7%) are about the song and 152 (6.4%) about the models, more than any product topic except design.
audience: Song and music fans, fans of the models

title: Answer price and where-to-buy questions in the video itself
action: Put the price range, the nearest store or the online link in the first lines of the description and in a pinned comment, and reply to these questions.
evidence: 248 comments (10.5%) ask about buying. The segment 'Price and where-to-buy askers' has 148 comments and 58% of them are direct questions. 298 comments are about price or location.

title: Zellbury: make buying easier
action: For Zellbury, add store and online links more visibly, since the most buying questions come here.
evidence: 17.0% of Zellbury comments ask about buying, the highest of the 6 brands with at least 150 comments (average 10.8%).

title: Respond publicly to complaints about trust, quality and sales
action: Reply to negative comments, explain returns and quality checks, and make sale terms clear in the video.
evidence: Share of negative comments by topic: price 10%, quality fabric 11%, discount sale 12%, trust complaint 67%. 'trust complaint' is the most negative topic.

title: Work with creators and keep a clear call to action in campaign films
action: Partner with creators and vloggers, whose 'creator video' videos get the most reaction per viewer, and add a question or a link to the official 'campaign film' videos.
evidence: Median engagement is 1.25 per 100 views for creator videos and 0.36 for campaign films. Third-party channels get 1.09 per 100 views, official channels 0.55.

title: Study the posts that beat their own group
action: Look at what these posts do differently (the creator, the hook, the title) and repeat it.
evidence: 'Aina Asif loving zellbury summer collection🌜#ainaasif #trending #viral' (Zellbury) has 3.7x the typical engagement of a creator video. 1 post is unusually strong without data problems.
